title: cleisostoma litoreum
intro: Cleisostoma litoreum, commonly known as the sea orchid, is a type of flowering plant in the orchid family (Orchidaceae). This plant is known for its potential health benefits, particularly in reducing inflammation and promoting wound healing due to its antimicrobial and antifungal properties. The therapeutic actions of Cleisostoma litoreum include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antibacterial activities, which contribute to its use in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
